title: 809. Subdomain Visit Count

examples.explanation: The single entry contributes its count to itself and to each parent suffix.

examples.output: ["901 mail.com","50 yahoo.com","900 google.mail.com","5 wiki.org","5 org","1 intel.mail.com","951 com"] (order may vary)
examples.explanation: Counts for shared suffixes such as com and mail.com are summed across entries.

hints: Split each entry at the first space to separate the visit count from the full domain.
Break the domain at every dot and accumulate the count for each suffix in a hash map.
